name: @dsh-desktop/shell
description: Electron shell of DSH Desktop: windows, preload, context isolation, renderer Node restrictions, application lifecycle, DSH child-process supervision, native OS handoff, and packaging. Owns no DSH sessions, tools, persistence, model execution, PTYs, or Cordis composition.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=lib/preload.cjs && esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outfile=lib/renderer.js
